title: Introduction to Machine Learning
text: An overview of supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, covering decision trees, neural networks, and how computers can learn patterns from data without being explicitly programmed.

title: The Art of French Pastry
text: A guide to classic French desserts including croissants, macarons, and souffles, with tips on working with butter, sugar, and yeast dough.

title: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
text: Explores the architecture of artificial neural networks, backpropagation, and how layered models recognize images and speech using large training datasets.

title: A History of the Roman Empire
text: Traces the rise and fall of Rome, from the founding of the republic through the reigns of the emperors and the eventual collapse of the Western Empire.

title: Baking Bread at Home
text: Step-by-step instructions for making sourdough and whole wheat loaves, discussing fermentation, kneading technique, and oven temperature.

title: Medieval Castles and Fortifications
text: Describes the design of stone keeps, moats, and defensive walls built by nobility during the Middle Ages to protect territory from invading armies.

title: Cataloging and Classification in Libraries
text: Discusses how librarians organize collections using controlled vocabularies, call numbers, and metadata standards like MARC and Dublin Core.

title: Database Normalization Principles
text: Explains how relational database schemas are structured to reduce redundancy, covering first, second, and third normal form with practical examples.

title: The Rise of Artificial Intelligence
text: A look at how intelligent software systems are trained to make predictions, recognize speech, and automate decisions once reserved for humans.

title: Information Retrieval and Search Engines
text: Examines how search systems index documents and rank results by relevance, including early Boolean retrieval and modern ranking algorithms.

title: Growing Vegetables in Small Gardens
text: Practical advice for planting tomatoes, peppers, and herbs in raised beds or containers, with guidance on soil, sunlight, and watering schedules.

title: Ancient Greek Philosophy
text: Surveys the ideas of Socrates, Plato, and Aristotle, including their views on ethics, government, and the nature of knowledge.

title: Metadata Standards for Digital Collections
text: Reviews metadata schemas such as Dublin Core and MODS used to describe digital objects so they can be discovered, cited, and preserved over time.

title: Composting for Beginners
text: Explains how to turn kitchen scraps and yard waste into nutrient-rich soil amendment using simple backyard composting bins.

title: Natural Language Processing Basics
text: Introduces tokenization, embeddings, and language models that allow computers to understand and generate human text for tasks like translation and chatbots.

title: The Printing Press and the Spread of Knowledge
text: Describes how Gutenberg's invention of movable type transformed the production of books and accelerated the spread of literacy across Europe.
